title: Engine Process Lifecycle & Recovery State Machine

operationalPhases.check: OS Process ID exists and Process.HasExited == false
Named Pipe client and server handles connected and streamable
HELLO / HELLO_ACK handshake completed with status == ACCEPTED and readiness in [READY, LOADING]; engineBusinessReady must equal (readiness == READY)
STATE_SNAPSHOT received, validated against the catalog projection schema, and applied by Host projection
engineBusinessReady == true (readiness == READY), CV models loaded, visual catalog initialized, ready for FRAME_READY processing

states.name: ENGINE_DOWN
states.description: Python process is not running (stopped, crashed, or pending initial spawn).

states.name: STARTING
states.description: Host has spawned child Python process; awaiting IPC pipe readiness.

states.name: HANDSHAKING
states.description: Named Pipe connected; Host emitted HELLO; awaiting HELLO_ACK. On reconnect/crash recovery, DIRECT transition to READY is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN.
states.readyTransitionGuard: Direct transition from HANDSHAKING to READY is strictly restricted to cold boot where noRecoverableBusinessState == true AND engineBusinessReady == true. On any reconnect or recovery, transition MUST proceed through SYNCING.

states.name: SYNCING
states.description: Handshake accepted; Host issued STATE_SNAPSHOT_REQUEST to rebuild match state after restart/reconnect.
states.readyTransitionGuard: Transition to READY requires STATE_SNAPSHOT validated and businessReady == true.

states.name: READY
states.description: Normal operating state. Heartbeat active, frames streaming, perception processing. Must simultaneously satisfy: 1. protocol negotiated, 2. capabilities accepted, 3. engine business ready, 4. snapshot requirement satisfied.

states.name: DEGRADED
states.description: Heartbeat missed, command rejected, or unsupported capability; running in safe fallback mode.

readyGateRequirements.rule: State machine transition to READY requires all 4 gates evaluated true simultaneously
readyGateRequirements.readinessAuthority: HELLO_ACK.readiness is the single authoritative engine-readiness field; HELLO_ACK.engineBusinessReady is its boolean READY-gate projection. The two must agree, and there is no separate 'modelStatus' protocol field in protocol 1.0.0 - model / catalog load state is folded into readiness (LOADING -> READY / FAILED).

readinessField.name: readiness
readinessField.consistencyRule: HELLO_ACK.status == ACCEPTED with readiness == READY requires engineBusinessReady == true; readiness in [STARTING, LOADING] or status != ACCEPTED requires engineBusinessReady == false. Enforced fail-closed by models.py::validate_hello_ack_readiness with ERR_SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED.

gates.condition: All mandatory capabilities AVAILABLE; WGC and WebView2 handled per fallback
HELLO_ACK.engineBusinessReady == true (which per message_catalog_v1.json readinessContract implies HELLO_ACK.readiness == READY) or STATE_SNAPSHOT.businessReady == true
Either (isColdBoot == true and noRecoverableBusinessState == true) OR (STATE_SNAPSHOT validated during SYNCING)

recoveryWorkflow.step1_detection: Host Process.Exited event fires (typically 8-15ms); Host UI preserves overlay and displays 'Reconnecting engine...'.
recoveryWorkflow.step2_drain: Host drains and closes stale Named Pipe handles; discards pending in-flight control messages.
recoveryWorkflow.step3_restart: Host supervisor spawns replacement Python process with fresh session nonce; transition to STARTING.
recoveryWorkflow.step4_handshake: Host initiates HELLO with sessionNonce, capability advertisement, frameBufferName and frameBufferSize (fixed v1 geometry - nothing about ring geometry is negotiated); transition to HANDSHAKING.
recoveryWorkflow.step5_sync_mandatory: On reconnect, Host transitions to SYNCING (direct transition to READY is forbidden) and emits STATE_SNAPSHOT_REQUEST.
recoveryWorkflow.step6_resync_verification: Engine serializes CurrentMatch projection in STATE_SNAPSHOT; Host verifies snapshotSequence and businessReady == true.
recoveryWorkflow.step7_ready: Host transitions to READY; frame streaming and perception resumes.

spikeAcknowledge.notes: Spike measured supervisor process exit detection (7.7ms) and mock restart (7.6ms). Full business recovery requiring model weight loading and match history recovery is explicitly marked NOT_MEASURED in this contract phase.
